basic_profile.bio: Hey, I'm a 16-year-old high school student from Texas, just getting my feet wet on Reddit. I enjoy drawing and writing in my spare time. Music is my escape, especially rock, with bands like Linkin Park and Foo Fighters being my go-to. I'm not much into sports, but I'm pretty active in my school's JROTC program, which keeps me busy and disciplined. I'm usually online in the evenings after school, around 7-10 PM CST. Currently single, and always open to making new friends and connections online!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been into drawing and writing since I was a kid, learning from online tutorials and classes at school. JROTC is teaching me leadership and discipline, which I find really valuable. My interest in music is more casual, but I love exploring new bands and genres.
